title: used to: lo que solías hacer antes
short: I used to play in the street. Used to + verbo = costumbres o situaciones del pasado que ya no existen (≈ «solía», «jugaba»).

story.title: Antes sí, ahora no
story.text: Para contar lo que hacías antes y ya no haces, el inglés tiene una fórmula: ==used to== + verbo. Es como nuestro «solía» o el pretérito imperfecto.

examples.t: I used to play in the street.

story.title: Las tres formas
story.text: Es igual para todas las personas. ¡Ojo con la -d! Con did / didn't desaparece.

story.title: Hábitos y situaciones
story.text: Sirve para ==costumbres repetidas== (jugar, ir, cocinar) y para ==situaciones== que duraban (tener, vivir, ser). There used to be = antes había.

examples.t: I used to have long hair.
There used to be a cinema here.

story.title: Solo para lo repetido
story.text: Si pasó ==una sola vez== o dices cuántas veces, usa el pasado simple, no used to.

story.title: Así en español, así en inglés
story.text: «Solía jugar» o «jugaba» → ==used to play==. Pero ¡ojo! used to solo existe en pasado: para «suelo» (presente) se dice ==usually==.

examples.t: I used to cook every day.

story.title: Errores típicos
story.text:
❌ I use to play. ✅ I ==used== to play.
❌ Did you used to…? ✅ Did you ==use== to…?
❌ I was used to play. ✅ I ==used to== play.
❌ I use to cook on Sundays. ✅ I ==usually== cook on Sundays.

story.title: used to ≠ be used to
story.text: ==I used to== live alone = antes vivía sola. ==I'm used to== living alone = estoy acostumbrada a vivir sola. ¡Una pequeña palabra lo cambia todo!

compare.es: En español contamos los hábitos de antes con el imperfecto (jugaba, vivía) o con «solía» + infinitivo. «Soler» también existe en presente: suelo, sueles.
compare.target: En inglés usamos used to + verbo base (I used to play), igual para todas las personas. Solo existe en pasado: para el presente se dice usually. Negativa y pregunta con did: didn't use to, Did you use to…?

errors.wrong: I use to play in the street.
errors.right: I used to play in the street.
errors.why: En afirmativa se escribe con -d, aunque no se oiga.

errors.wrong: Did you used to live here?
errors.right: Did you use to live here?
errors.why: Did ya marca el pasado: use to, sin -d.

errors.wrong: I was used to play with dolls.
errors.right: I used to play with dolls.
errors.why: Was used to significa «estaba acostumbrada». Para «solía», solo used to.

errors.wrong: I use to go to the gym on Mondays.
errors.right: I usually go to the gym on Mondays.
errors.why: Used to no existe en presente: «suelo» = usually.

errors.wrong: I used to go to Sydney last year.
errors.right: I went to Sydney last year.
errors.why: Una sola vez, en un momento concreto: pasado simple.
Después de used to, el verbo en forma base, sin -ing.

exercises.q: When I was a child, I ___ play in the street.
exercises.why: Costumbre del pasado en afirmativa: used to, con -d.

exercises.q: My friends and I ___ to go dancing on Saturdays.
exercises.why: Afirmativa: used to + go.

exercises.q: We didn't ___ have a washing machine.
exercises.why: Tras didn't, use to sin -d.

exercises.q: Did you ___ walk to school?
exercises.why: Pregunta: Did + you + use to.

exercises.q: I ___ have breakfast at eight. It's my routine now.
exercises.why: Es un hábito de ahora: usually. Used to solo es pasado.

exercises.q: Last summer we ___ to Sydney for two weeks.
exercises.why: Un viaje concreto, una vez: pasado simple.

exercises.q: I lived in the north for years, so I'm ___ the cold.
exercises.why: Be used to + algo = estar acostumbrada a algo.

exercises.q: I ___ to have very long hair.
exercises.es: Antes tenía el pelo muy largo.
answer: used
exercises.why: Situación del pasado: used to have.

exercises.q: There used to ___ a bakery next to the church.
exercises.es: Antes había una panadería al lado de la iglesia.
answer: be
exercises.why: There used to be = antes había.

exercises.q: She didn't use to ___ meat, but now she does.
exercises.es: Antes no comía carne, pero ahora sí.
answer: eat
exercises.why: Después de use to, verbo base: eat.

exercises.q: ___ you use to go to the beach in summer?
answer: Did
exercises.why: La pregunta empieza con Did.

exercises.q: We ___ use to travel much. We had no money!
exercises.es: No solíamos viajar mucho. ¡No teníamos dinero!
answer: didn't
did not
exercises.why: Negativa: didn't use to.

exercises.q: My neighbour ___ in a factory.
answer: used to work
exercises.why: Used to + work, igual para todas las personas.

exercises.q: I ___ fish, but now I love it.
answer: didn't use to like
did not use to like
exercises.why: Negativa: didn't use to like.

exercises.q: Where ___ when you were young?
answer: did you use to live
exercises.why: Where + did + you + use to + live.

exercises.q: As a child, I played the piano every afternoon.
answer: As a child, I used to play the piano every afternoon.
As a child, I used to play the piano.
exercises.why: Hábito repetido del pasado: used to play.

exercises.q: We used to eat out a lot.
answer: We didn't use to eat out a lot.
We did not use to eat out a lot.
exercises.why: Negativa: didn't use to (sin -d).

exercises.q: She used to sing in a choir.
answer: Did she use to sing in a choir?
exercises.why: Pregunta: Did she use to…?

exercises.instr: Escríbela con there used to be
exercises.q: There was a cinema in the square. It's a bank now.
answer: There used to be a cinema in the square.
There used to be a cinema in the square. It's a bank now.
exercises.why: Algo que había antes y ya no: there used to be.

exercises.instr: Pregunta por el lugar con Where
exercises.q: You used to play in the park.
answer: Where did you use to play?
exercises.why: Where + did + you + use to + play.

exercises.q: I use to play hide-and-seek with my friends.
exercises.why: Afirmativa: used to, con -d.

exercises.q: Did your parents used to take you to the beach?
exercises.why: Con did, use to sin -d.

exercises.q: We didn't used to have a car.
exercises.why: Con didn't, use to sin -d.

exercises.q: I used to playing with dolls.
exercises.why: Used to + verbo base: play.

exercises.q: Now I use to walk every morning.
exercises.why: En presente no existe use to: «suelo» = usually.

exercises.es: Antes vivíamos en un piso pequeño
exercises.answer: We used to live in a small flat
exercises.why: Used to + live.

exercises.answer: Did you use to go to the cinema on Sundays
exercises.why: Did + you + use to (sin -d).

exercises.es: Antes no me gustaba el café
exercises.answer: I didn't use to like coffee
exercises.why: didn't use to + like.

exercises.q: De pequeña jugaba a las canicas.
answer: As a child, I used to play marbles.
When I was little, I used to play marbles.
When I was a child, I used to play marbles.
I used to play marbles as a child.
I used to play marbles when I was little.
exercises.why: Hábito del pasado: used to play.

exercises.q: Antes había un mercado aquí.
answer: There used to be a market here.
exercises.why: Antes había = there used to be.

exercises.q: I didn't use to like vegetables.
answer: Antes no me gustaban las verduras.
No me gustaban las verduras.
Antes no me gustaba la verdura.
No solían gustarme las verduras.
exercises.why: Didn't use to like = antes no me gustaba.

exercises.q: I'm used to getting up early.
answer: Estoy acostumbrada a madrugar.
Estoy acostumbrada a levantarme temprano.
Estoy acostumbrado a levantarme temprano.
Estoy acostumbrada a levantarme pronto.
exercises.why: Be used to + -ing = estar acostumbrada a.

exercises.context: Una amiga te pregunta si siempre has llevado gafas. Antes no llevabas.
options: No, I didn't use to wear glasses.
No, I didn't used to wear glasses.
No, I'm not used to wear glasses.
exercises.answer: No, I didn't use to wear glasses.
exercises.why: Negativa de used to: didn't use to + wear.

exercises.context: Tu nieto te pregunta si de joven bailabas. ¡Bailabas todos los sábados!
options: Yes, I used to dance every Saturday.
Yes, I use to dance every Saturday.
Yes, I was used to dance every Saturday.
exercises.answer: Yes, I used to dance every Saturday.
exercises.why: Costumbre de antes: used to dance.
Cuatro frases parecidas con significados distintos.

exercises.t: I used to walk to school with my friends.
exercises.es: Iba andando al colegio con mis amigas.
